import json

from shelf import books, export


def setup_function():
    books.clear()


def test_dump_round_trips_whole_catalogue():
    books.add("Dune", "Frank Herbert")
    books.add("Emma", "Jane Austen")
    assert json.loads(export.dump()) == [
        {"title": "Dune", "author": "Frank Herbert"},
        {"title": "Emma", "author": "Jane Austen"},
    ]


def test_dump_empty_shelf():
    assert export.dump() == "[]"


def test_dump_author_filter_keeps_only_that_author():
    books.add("Dune", "Frank Herbert")
    books.add("Dune Messiah", "Frank Herbert")
    books.add("Emma", "Jane Austen")
    rows = json.loads(export.dump(author="Frank Herbert"))
    assert [b["title"] for b in rows] == ["Dune", "Dune Messiah"]


def test_dump_unknown_author_is_empty():
    books.add("Emma", "Jane Austen")
    assert export.dump(author="Nobody") == "[]"
